  <script>
  (function () {
    var todayClass = "monday";
    var carousel = document.querySelector('.weekly-schedule-carousel');
    if (!carousel) return;

    var todayEl = carousel.querySelector('.wp-block-uagb-advanced-heading.' + todayClass);
    if (!todayEl) return;

    // Remove stale is-today (e.g. from cache)
    carousel.querySelectorAll('.is-today').forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.remove('is-today');
    });
    todayEl.classList.add('is-today');

    function centerToday() {
      if (window.innerWidth > 768) return;

      var c = carousel.getBoundingClientRect();
      var t = todayEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      var scrollLeft =
        carousel.scrollLeft +
        (t.left - c.left) -
        (c.width / 2) +
        (t.width / 2);

      carousel.scrollTo({
        left: Math.max(0, scrollLeft),
        behavior: 'smooth'
      });
    }

    // After layout / fonts
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      centerToday();
      setTimeout(centerToday, 150);
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', centerToday);
  })();
  </script>
